appearance: 50s, prosperous build gone soft with grief.
and_yet: Still dressed well — hasn't stopped caring about appearances even now.
wants: Proof that Savar sent his son to his death.
does_not_want: To hear that Jorun went willingly.
oddly_also: Hasn't opened his warehouse in six weeks — losing money daily and doesn't care.
family: Wife Pemma, holding the household together; Jorun (son, missing, 21); two younger daughters.
self_image: A father who failed to see what was happening.
anecdotes: Built the Cadek house from a single mule cart twenty years ago.
tragedies: Jorun left for the Mountain of Fire six weeks ago and has not returned.
pc_leverage: Has money. Will hire the party. Is not wrong about what happened.
